name: Bromadoline
summary: Bromadoline (U-47931E) is an opioid analgesic selective for the μ-opioid receptor developed by the Upjohn company in the 1970s. The drug has a potency lying between that of codeine and morphine, being slightly stronger than pentazocine. Bromadoline is related to AH-7921 and U-47700.

pharmacology.text: Bromadoline (U-47931E) is an opioid analgesic selective for the μ-opioid receptor developed by the Upjohn company in the 1970s.

summaryZh: 溴朵林是一種有機化合物，化學式為C15H21BrN2O，它是Upjohn公司於1970年代研發的對μ-阿片受體具有選擇性的類阿片鎮痛藥，其藥效介於可待因和嗎啡之間，略強於噴他佐辛。
summaryZhHans: 溴朵林是一种有机化合物，化学式为C15H21BrN2O，它是Upjohn公司于1970年代研发的对μ-阿片受体具有选择性的类阿片镇痛药，其药效介于可待因和吗啡之间，略强于喷他佐辛。

sideEffects.en: It has barely been studied in people. Like other opioids it causes drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and strong opioids can cause fatal overdose and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 它在人體中幾乎沒有研究。和其他鴉片類一樣，它會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，而強效鴉片類可能導致致命過量與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它在人体中几乎没有研究。和其他鸦片类一样，它会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，而强效鸦片类可能导致致命过量与成瘾。

fact.en: Its code, U-47931E, places it in the same Upjohn series as U-47700, which later appeared as a street drug. Bromadoline sits between codeine and morphine in strength.
fact.zh: 它的代號 U-47931E 顯示它與後來出現在街頭的 U-47700 同屬 Upjohn 的同一系列。溴朵林的效力介於可待因與嗎啡之間。
fact.zhHans: 它的代号 U-47931E 显示它与后来出现在街头的 U-47700 同属 Upjohn 的同一系列。溴朵林的效力介于可待因与吗啡之间。
